additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386773-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / S5 313688776001] Outlets out of order after charging session CRM:00643001034
additional_info.body:
Hi Jose
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the issue with the outlets being set to "Faulted" after attempted charging sessions, we have analyzed the logs from the past day. On multiple occasions, we observed that when the charging session started during the authorization phase, the status of the scanned ID tag from the backend was marked as "Invalid."
Please check with the backend to confirm whether the customer is using the correct ID tag. If the ID tag is correct, ensure that it is included in the authorization list.
Below are some charger logs for your reference, where you can see the status.
2024-10-28, 07:37:55 Session_Stop
OCPP: Send command: Authorize (7fdc099f-bc59-489b-9fd4-f0fef1d84037) - {"idTag":"F0A0BB93"}
OCPP: Received result: Authorize (7fdc099f-bc59-489b-9fd4-f0fef1d84037) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid"}}
2024-10-28, 07:39:40 Session_Stop
OCPP: Send command: Authorize (457c8e56-29fd-479f-a6c6-05423090faf4) - {"idTag":"F0A0BB93"}
OCPP: Received result: Authorize (457c8e56-29fd-479f-a6c6-05423090faf4) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid"}}
2024-10-28, 07:39:48 Sesion_Stop
No Authorization done for this session
2024-10-28, 17:08:26 Session+Stop
OCPP: Send command: Authorize (0eb6d0b4-a470-4df0-8917-c97abad74d70) - {"idTag":"048F6EFAE96F80"}
OCPP: Received result: Authorize (0eb6d0b4-a470-4df0-8917-c97abad74d70) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid"}}
2024-10-28, 17:11:54 Session_Stop
OCPP: Send command: Authorize (d9ede1d8-2217-4208-9f8f-22e6b99e79df) - {"idTag":"048F6EFAE96F80"}
OCPP: Received result: Authorize (d9ede1d8-2217-4208-9f8f-22e6b99e79df) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid"}}
2024-10-28, 17:29:10 Session_Stop
No Authorization done for this session
I hope your queries have been addressed. If there are no further questions, shall we proceed with closing this case?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386773-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / S5 313688776001] Outlets out of order after charging session CRM:00643001034
additional_info.body:
Dear Sunil
Here the response from the backend switch-ev. I think you can close the ticket.
Best regards
José
Hi Jose,
My colleague has had a look at the logs and those "invalid" results for the authorizations are correct behaviour, I can see that the requests went all the way to Hubject and which then returned NotAuthorized to the platform.
In addition to this the identifiers are not saved in the platform so they won't be white labelled there:
- F0A0BB93
- 048F6EFAE96F80
So if the charger is starting the session that is not correct, because the tokens have not been authorized.
Hope this helps.
Kind regards,
Hugo
